dem.sourceDtm: AWS Terrain Tiles terrarium z14 (SRTM) clipped to the supplied Varthur box KML. Interior bed is a modelled 2.3 m bowl because SRTM returns the water surface inside the lake.

baseline_specs.sourceAttribution: Lake outline from the supplied Varthur KML. Terrain from AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM) over the supplied box. The lake bed below the water surface is a modelled bowl (maximum 2.3 m), not a hydrographic survey.
